claim_boundary: No product-superiority, SOTA, revolutionary, replacement, validation, or held-out claim is permitted unless an exact-SHA v4 admission artifact passes every frozen gate.

candidate.ingestion: Identical blind structural compiler to v3: numbered fact, explicit Document N section, blank-line-delimited paragraph, or upstream MemOps session. Answer, gold, scorer, validation, and final fields remain unavailable.
candidate.evaluation_storage: Append every definition to the hash-chained scientific event log. Do not duplicate evaluation-only units into the legacy vector substrate because the frozen selector reads the event log directly. Production recall remains fail-closed and cannot see evaluation-only units until causal promotion and explicit production indexing.
candidate.document_segmentation: Split at line-start ^Document [0-9]+: markers; otherwise split at existing blank-line boundaries; retain official chunks only when no structural boundary exists.
candidate.reconciliation: Keep the highest source-order parsed value per normalized subject-relation key; explicit deletion creates a retrieval-ineligible tombstone while raw provenance remains auditable.
candidate.retrieval: Deterministic query-token IDF over active structural units; for claims, exact query-entity seeds and at most four active graph links; at most twenty units under frozen budgets; ties by source recency then memory ID.
candidate.evaluation_only: No production eligibility is granted. Rows without a selected memory or with byte-identical paired prompts are invalid and excluded from uplift.
candidate.production_promotion: 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound strictly greater than zero, at least five independent clusters, three reproducible runs, and zero false verified promotions.

allowed: MemoryAgentBench units labeled development in the frozen split manifest
MemOps subjects labeled development in the frozen evaluation split manifest
STATE-Bench development learning trajectories already prepared without validation/final execution
development_scope.candidate_changes_after_development_outc: A changed mechanism requires a new protocol version and digest; thresholds and admission gates may never be weakened.

development_gate.cluster_identity: content or subject fingerprint; repeated rows with the same fingerprint are one cluster

terminal_rule: If the frozen v4 candidate does not pass the development gate, report failed_experiment_v4 and create no validation, held-out, admission, SOTA, or revolutionary claim. Public WaveField descriptions and WaveMind Connect remain unchanged.
